msContents.summary: A Malayalam manuscript of the Mahābhārata Āraṇyakaparvan.

lg.l: jaḷāñ copajaḷāñ caiva yamunām abhito nadīṃ |
uśīnānaro vai yatreṣṭvā vāsavād atiricyate | 17 |

tān devasamitis tasya vāsava
ś ca viśāṃ pate |
abhyagacśata rājānaṃ jñātum agniś ca bhārata | 18 | 18 |
jijñāsamānau varadau mahātmānam uśīnaraṃ |
indra śyenaḥ kapoto gnir bhūtvā yajñe bhijagmatuḥ | 19 |
ūruṃ rājñas samāviśya kapotaś śyenajād bhayāt |

śaraṇārthī tadā rā
jñāja nililye bhayapīḍitaḥ | 20 |

body.p: ❈ | ity āraṇyake tīrtthayātrāyāṃ śyenakapotīye ekatriṃśacśatatamo dhyāyaḥ | ❈ |

lg.l: dharmmātmānan tv āhur ekaṃ sarvve rājan mahīkṣitaḥ |
sa vai dharmmaviruddhan tvaṃ kasmāt_ karmma cikīrṣasi | 1 |
vihitaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ rājan_ pīḍyamānasya me kṣudhā
mā bhāṅkṣīr ddharmmalobhena dharmmam utsṛjyamān aśeḥ | 2 |
santrastarūpas trāṇārtthī tvatto bhīto mahādvija |
matsakāśam anuprātaḥ prāṇagṛddhnur ayan dvijaḥ | 3 |

evam abhyāgatasyeha ka
potasyābhayārtthinaḥ |
apradāno | paro dharmme kan tvaṃ śyeneha paśyasi | 4 |
praspandamānas saṃbhrāntaḥ kapotaś śyena lakṣyate |
matsakāśañ jīvitārtthī tasya tyāgo vigārhitaḥ | 5 |
āhārāt sarvvabhūtāni saṃbhavanti mahīpate |
āhāreṇa vivarddhante tena jīvanti jantavaḥ | 6 |
śakyate dustyaje py artthe cirarātrāya jīvituṃ |
na tu bhojanam utsṛjya śakyaṃ varttayituñ ciraṃ | 7 |
bhakṣād vilopitasyādya mama prāṇā viśāṃ pate |

visṛjya kāyam eṣyanti pa
nthānam apunarbhavaṃ | 8 |
pramṛte mayi dharmmātman_ putradāran naśiṣyati |
rakṣamānaḥ kapotan tvaṃ bāhūn_ prāṇān narakṣasi | 9 |
bahun yo bādhate dharmmo na sa dharmmaḥ kudharmmavartma tat_
avirodhī tu yo dharmmas sa dharmmas satyavikrama | 10 |

vi
rodhiṣu mahīpāla niścitya gurulāghavaṃ |
na bādhā vidyate yatra tad dharmmaṃ samupācaret | 11 |
gurulāghavam ajñāya dharmmādharmmaviniścaye |
yato bhūyāṃs tato rājan_ kuru dharmmaviniścayaṃ | 12 |

bahukalyāṇasaṃyu
ktaṃ bhāṣase vihagottama |
suparṇṇaḥ pakṣirāṭ_ kin tvaṃ dharmmajña tvābhibhāṣase | 13 |
tathā hi dharmmasaṃyuktaṃ bahu citraṃ vibhāṣase |
na te sty aviditaṃ kiñcid iti tvā lakṣayāmy ahaṃ | 14 |

śaraṇaiṣiṇaḥ parityāgaṃ kaś ca sāddhv iti
manyate |
hriyamāṇan tathāhāram utpannaṃ kṣudhitasya vai | 15 |
āhārārtthe samāraṃbhas tava cāyaṃ vihaṃgama |
śakyaś cāpy anyathā karttum āhāro bhyadhikās tvayā | 16 |
govṛṣo vā varāho vā mṛgo vā mahiṣo pi vā

tvada
rttham adya kriyatāṃ yad vānyad abhikāṃkṣase | 17 |
na varāvin na cokṣāṇan na mṛgān vividhāṃs tathā |
bhakṣayāmi mahārāja kinnam annād yena tena me | 18 |
yas tu me devavihito bhakṣaḥ kṣatriyapuṃgava |

tam utsṛja mahīpālaṃ kapotam imam e
mava me | 19 |
śyenāḥ kapotān_ khādanti sthitir eṣā sanātanī |
mā rājan mārggam ājñāya kadalīskandham āsajaḥ | 20 |
rājyaṃ śibīnām ṛddhaṃ hi śādhi pakṣigaṇārccita |
kṛtsnam etan mayā dattaṃ rājavadvihagottama | 21 |

yad vā kāmayase kāmaṃ śye
nama sarvvan dadāni te |
vinemaṃ pakṣiṇaṃ śyena śaraṇārtthinam āgataṃ | 22 |
yena vā varttayethās tvaṃ karmmaṇā pakṣisattama |
tadācakṣva kariṣyāmi na hi dāsye kapotakaṃ | 23 |
uśīnara kapote te yadi sneho narādhipa
ātmamāṃsam samut_kṛtya kapotatulayā dhṛtaṃ | 24 |
yadā samaṃ kapotena tava māṃsaṃ bhaven nṛpa
tadā pradeyan tan mahyaṃ sā me tuṣṭir bhaviṣyati | 25 |
anugraham imaṃ manye śyena yan mābhiyācase |

tasmāt te dya pradāsyāmi svamāṃ
saṃn tulayā dhṛtaṃ | 26 |
athot_kṛtya svamāṃsan tu rājā paramadharmmavit |
tulayāmāsa kaunteya kapotena sahābhibho | 27 |
dhriyamāṇas tu tulayā kapoto vyatiricyate |

punaś cot_kṛtya māṃsāni
rājā prādād uśīnaraḥ | 28 |
na vidyate yadā māṃsaṃ kapotena saman dhṛtaṃ |
tata ut_kṛtyamāṃsaṃ svam āruroha svayan tulāṃ | 29 |
indro ham asmi dharmmajña kapoto havyavāḍ ayaṃ |

jijñāsamā
nau dharmmae tvā yajñavāṭam ihāgatau | 30 |
yat te māṃsāni gātrebhya ut_kṛttāni viśāṃ pate |
eṣā te śāśvatī kīrttir llokān abhibhaviṣyati | 31 |
yāval loke manuṣyās tvāṃ kathayiṣyanti pārthiva |
tāvat_ kīrttiś ca lokāś ca sthāsyanti tava śāśvatāḥ | 32 |
tat_ pāṇḍaveya sadanaṃ rājñas tasya mahātmanaḥ |
paśyas vai tan mayā sārddhaṃ puṇyaṃ prpāpapramocanaṃ | 33 |

atraiva satatan devā munayaś ca
tapodhanāḥ |
dṛśyante brāhmaṇai rājan_ puṇyakṛdbhir mmahātmabhiḥ | 34 |

body.p: ❈ ity āraṇyake dvātriṃśacśattamo dhyāyaḥ | ❈ | śyenakapotīyaṃ samāptaṃ | ❈
